title: 80s-style bass loop for a game – feedback wanted! 🔥
author: Particular_Sir5426
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I created a simple but groovy bass loop for use as game background music. It’s inspired by classic 80s pop/funk bass lines (I would like to see you guess the song what kind of energy is that), but I changed the notes and arrangement to make it original.

And I'm considering, is it plagiat or not? what do you think? I generated it with AI, I was inspired, but that's not same music. :/ 

Here’s how it turned out:

[https://suno.com/s/HCPMfeEI4FmzV777](https://suno.com/s/HCPMfeEI4FmzV777) 

**Details:**

* 94 BPM
* A minor
* Almost pure clean electric fingerstyle bass guitar
* Very bass-heavy mix
* Seamless repeating loop

I’d love some honest feedback:

* How does the groove feel?
* Is the bass prominent and powerful enough?
* Would this work well as background music in a game (casual / arcade / chill vibe)?
* What would you change or improve?

Especially interested in opinions from bass players and game audio people.
